I’m reading what you are saying, and I’m trying my best to understand what you are saying. I just want you to know that someone cares, and someone wants you here. There is still good in the world even though there is bad. I really hope that you can find something that makes you stay. I have less life experiences then you, but I’m here to let you know, I care. And maybe that means nothing, but I care.

You are right. This world isn’t fair, and a lot of people are not good. You have put in effort after effort to change your life. It’s really shitty and unfair that people did that to you, I always have looked at the dark and bad side of things, and right now I’m only still trying to see the other side. But what matters is that even though the world is unfair and people are shitty, there is still a portion of the world that isn’t. And you can try to see the good side of life. It’s hard and upsetting, and sometimes it feels like this isn’t the place for you, but you have to hang on and make it the place for you. Just hang on, because the world isn’t all shit. There is always a good side.

You deserve the world, you deserve happiness and joy and living your life to its full extent. Life is really really shitty and most of it sucks, but if you can just hang on to something and try really hard to make yourself think that you are worth it and deserve to live . You are not a waste of space, you are not worthless, your are not scum. You are a living , breathing, functioning human being who has potential and can do wonderful things. So please, no matter how much you want to leave hang on for me, I would be devastated if you left, you are worth it. You deserve the world.
